qa_pair.question: Find the alias-free basic analog oscillator, then its parameter controlling how many detuned copies play. What is its maximum? Return an integer.
Find the basic analog oscillator and compare the highest coarse pitch adjustment with the greatest hard-sync shift. How many semitones greater is the latter? Return an integer.
Find the analog ADSR modulator. Compare the documented maximum durations of the attack and release stages. What is their ratio, attack divided by release? Return an integer.
Find the standard periodic low-frequency modulator. Its delay and rise parameters share a documented maximum. What is their combined maximum in seconds? Return an integer.
Inspect the standard oscillator and its fine pitch adjustment. What is the full adjustment span, expressed in cents? Return an integer.
Compare the overall voice limit on a Program and its same-note voice limit in the bundled catalog. What is the smallest permitted same-note value? Return an integer.
Inspect the Keygroup's lower and upper velocity boundaries. What is the smallest MIDI velocity supported by BOTH boundary parameters? Return an integer.
Compare the stereo pan ranges on Part, Program and Keygroup. Do all three cover exactly the same interval? Return True or False.
Find the simple output-gain effect, then compare its internal level parameter name with the corresponding parameter on a Program. Return the effect's internal parameter name.
Find SparkVerb. Compare its two documented frequency crossover ranges. What is the difference between the minimum upper crossover and maximum lower crossover, in Hz? Return an integer.
